messages:
deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Canary failure detected for embed-service in eu-west1. 12% 5xx across canary nodes, rollout paused and auto-fallback blocked. Requesting expedited decision: pin previous stable image or allow emergency rollback. 

liz: Seeing the alert. Impact on production requests? how bad is the latency/error spread? :eyes:

rahul: quick look at traces shows N+1 errors from the new quant path — likely model runtime. Giving us degraded embeddings for some customers.

deploybot: Canary detail: https://internal-telemetry/reports/canary/6765432100 (metric snapshot + logs). Failed checks: error_rate > 10% threshold, avg latency +120ms.

samira: we need an expedite. My vote: pin traffic to redwood/embed:v1.2.4-hotfix (previous stable) and abort the v1.2.5 rollout. Ops, do you have bandwidth to assist with rollback choreography?

ops_oncall: I can run the traffic pin now and watch. If we do pin, monitor for 15m. If error_rate > 5% then trigger full rollback to v1.2.3 and page SRE.

liz: +1 to pin and escort. Can anyone run the release command? I'll update release notes after. :thumbsup:

rahul: running the pin CLI now:
```
/releasebot pin --service embed-service --image redwood/embed:v1.2.4-hotfix --reason "canary failures v1.2.5" --escalation expedite
```

releasebot: Command received. Verifying image and policy... ACL OK. Applying pin and starting traffic reroute (canary -> stable). ETA 45s.

deploybot: Reroute complete. Traffic pinned to redwood/embed:v1.2.4-hotfix. Canary v1.2.5 instances scaled down.

samira: documented in release notes draft: https://redwood-release-notes/internal/6789 — added rollback rationale and timeline.

ops_oncall: monitoring: error_rate dropped back to baseline ~0.8%. Latency normalized. I'll keep watch for 15m and update. If anything spikes, I'll issue rollback to v1.2.3 and start incident channel.

liz: thanks all. tagging legal/compliance if required. Recording this as expedited pin per policy. Closing thread when ops confirms stable for 15m. :white_check_mark:

rahul: adding a postmortem todo: investigate quant path config drift between images.

ops_oncall: stable at +20m, no regressions. Marking as resolved. Closing expedite window.
